name: ibis Styles Solo
short_description: A design-economy hotel on Jalan Gajahmada in central Solo, walkable to city sights and about 20 minutes from Adisumarmo Airport.
ai_summary: ibis Styles Solo sits on Jalan Gajahmada in the Timuran area of Banjarsari, Surakarta, within walking distance of Solo's city-centre attractions and about 20 minutes' drive from Adisumarmo Airport and 5 minutes from Balapan train station. Independent aggregator listings describe two pools and colourful, modern rooms typical of the ibis Styles design-economy format. The hotel's own ALL booking page could not be loaded directly for this research pass -- facts here are cross-checked across Trip.com and Hotels.com listings rather than the official page.
